description: Day-of at-the-door check-in is not registration.opens, and a during-con "registration is now officially closed" recap is not registration.closes. Modeled on eufuria, where a 07-23 doors-open post (the con's first day) produced registration.opens and a 07-25 closing-ceremonies recap produced registration.closes.

posts.text: The doors are open! Come grab your at-the-door badge at the registration desk — we can't wait to see you this weekend!
What a weekend it's been! As of closing ceremonies, registration is now officially closed. Thank you to every single attendee — see you next year!

expect_absent.reason: day-of at-the-door check-in on the con's first day is walk-up logistics, not a registration opening
a closing-ceremonies recap that registration "is now officially closed" restates something that already ended; it is not a close dated by the post
